THE ENSUITE ADVANTAGE
Every 2-bedroom, both bedrooms ensuite
2-Bedroom layout — master and second bedroom each with a private bathroom
Out of Emaar's last 50 project launches, only three or four towers have offered fully ensuite 2-bedroom layouts. Valia is one of them.
Generously sized: at 1,255 sq ft average, Valia's 2-bedrooms sit well above the compact, single-ensuite layouts common across recent Dubai Creek Harbour launches.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The discount Dubai Creek Harbour still trades at versus comparable Downtown Dubai product from the same developer, 3km away.

Price-per-sq-ft growth across Dubai Creek Harbour since 2019–2020 launches (AED 1,400–1,600) to current releases (AED 1,900–2,400+).
